faq.sectionSubtitle: Quick answers to the most common questions about joining and using the Olympic HUMG ecosystem.
faq.a1: The system is specially designed for students and lecturers at Hanoi University of Mining and Geology who are passionate about Olympic subjects and wish to improve their skills and participate in competitions at various levels.
faq.q2: How do I join online exams?
faq.a2: To participate, log in with your student/lecturer account. Then, go to 'Competitions', select an exam with open registration or 'Upcoming' status, and follow the instructions. Some internal exams may require an access code from a Lecturer.
faq.q3: Can I review my results and exam history?
faq.a3: Absolutely. Your complete exam history, scores, and rankings are stored in 'My Profile'. You can also review detailed submissions to learn from your mistakes.
faq.q4: Are the resources on the platform free?
faq.a4: Yes, all resources including past exams, specialized materials, and lectures are shared completely free of charge to support HUMG students' learning and preparation.
faq.q5: How can I join the Olympic team?
faq.a5: You can follow team recruitment announcements on the 'News' or 'Community' pages. When recruitment opens, the system will provide registration forms or organize online aptitude tests for selection.
faq.q6: How are rankings and recognition calculated?
faq.a6: Rankings are based on XP (Experience Points) accumulated from activities: taking exams, posting on forums, earning badges, etc. The leaderboard updates in real-time, motivating you to reach higher ranks.
